# Modem Pay

> Modem Pay is a payments API for The Gambia. Accept Wave, Afrimoney, QMoney, APS, Yonna, card and stablecoin payments, send mobile money payouts, split revenue with partners, and send invoices. REST API at https://api.modempay.com/v1, authenticated with `Authorization: Bearer sk_...`. SDKs: modem-pay (npm), modempay (pip), modempay/modempay-php (Composer).

## Get started

- [Modem Pay documentation](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/introduction): Accept mobile money and card payments, pay people, split revenue and settle stablecoins in dalasi, all through one API.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/quickstart): Accept your first payment with Modem Pay in a few minutes.
- [SDKs and libraries](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/installation): Install the Modem Pay library for Node.js, Python or PHP.
- [API keys](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/authentication): How to authenticate, and how to limit what each key can do.
- [Test mode and going live](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/test-mode): Build without moving real money, then switch on live payments with confidence.
- [Errors](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/errors): What errors look like, what each status means, and when to retry.

## Developer tools

- [Modem Pay CLI](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/cli): Get test webhooks on your laptop, send sample events and create test payments, all from your terminal.

## Accept payments

- [Choose an integration](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/payments/overview): Five ways to accept payments, from no code at all to full control.
- [Payment links](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/core/payment-links): A link you share anywhere. Customers open it and pay. No website or code needed.
- [Pay button](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/payments/drop-in): One HTML tag adds a Modem Pay button to any page. No build step, no framework.
- [Checkout pop-up](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/payments/modem-inline): Open Modem Pay's checkout in a pop-up on your page, and react to the result in JavaScript.
- [HTML Checkout](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/payments/html-checkout): Accept payments with a plain HTML form. No backend, no JavaScript.
- [Your own checkout](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/payments/custom): Create payments on your server, send customers to pay, and confirm with a webhook. A complete example.

## Payment intents

- [Payment intents](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/payment-intents/overview): The object behind every payment: create one on your server, send the customer to pay, then confirm the result.
- [Create a payment intent](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/payment-intents/create): Four common ways to create a payment, from just an amount to a saved customer's wallet.
- [Direct charge](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/payment-intents/direct-charge): Charge a mobile wallet directly. The customer just confirms on their phone.
- [Check, list and cancel](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/payment-intents/management): Confirm a payment on your server, see recent payments, and cancel ones you no longer need.
- [Callback URL](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/payment-intents/callback_url): Send one payment's events to its own URL, instead of your account webhook.
- [Refunds](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/payment-intents/refund): Give a customer their money back, in full or in part.

## Customers and discounts

- [Customers](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/core/customers): Save the people who pay you, so checkout is faster next time.
- [Mandates](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/core/mandates): Proof that a customer agreed to save their payment method.
- [Coupons](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/core/coupons): Give discounts: a percentage or a fixed amount, with expiry dates, usage limits and minimum spends.

## Send money

- [Payouts](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/payouts/overview): Send money from your Modem Pay balance to mobile wallets, one person or a thousand at a time.
- [Send a mobile money payout](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/payouts/mobile-money): Send money from your balance to a Wave or Afrimoney wallet.
- [Bulk payouts](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/payouts/bulk-payout)
- [Payout fees](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/payouts/fees): See exactly what a payout will cost before you send it.
- [Daily limits and queued payouts](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/payouts/daily-limits): Check how much you can still send today, and what happens to payouts once the daily limit is reached.
- [Reverse a payout](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/payouts/reversals): Pull back a Wave payout sent by mistake, within 3 days.

## Split payments

- [Split payments](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/split-payments/overview)
- [Sub-accounts](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/split-payments/sub-accounts)
- [Sub-account groups](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/split-payments/sub-account-groups)
- [Split a payment](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/split-payments/initialize-payment)

## Stablecoins

- [Stablecoins overview](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/stablecoins/overview): Accept USDT and USDC, or convert them into dalasi, without handling wallets or blockchains yourself.
- [Accept stablecoin payments](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/stablecoins/accept-payments): Charge customers in USD and let them pay with USDT or USDC on a hosted page.
- [Convert stablecoins to dalasi](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/stablecoins/convert-to-dalasi): Send USDT or USDC and receive Gambian dalasi in your balance or a mobile money wallet. Also known as an off-ramp.
- [Price estimates](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/stablecoins/price-estimates): See what a conversion will cost or pay out before creating it.
- [Resell conversions](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/stablecoins/resellers): Offer stablecoin-to-dalasi conversions on your own platform and earn a markup.

## In person

- [Virtual terminals](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/virtual-terminal): A QR code for every counter, with instant WhatsApp alerts when someone pays.

## Your money

- [Balances](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/core/balances): Where your money is, and when you can spend it.
- [Transactions](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/core/transactions): Every payment attempt and its result: who paid, how, how much, and when.

## Webhooks and testing

- [Webhooks](https://docs.modempay.com/documentation/core/webhooks): Get told the moment a payment, payout, customer or invoice changes.

## Billing: Invoices

- [Invoices](https://docs.modempay.com/billing/invoices/introduction): Itemised bills with due dates, reminders and overdue tracking. Also the simplest way to charge subscriptions.
- [Send your first invoice](https://docs.modempay.com/billing/invoices/quickstart)
- [Invoice types](https://docs.modempay.com/billing/invoices/types)
- [Invoice lifecycle](https://docs.modempay.com/billing/invoices/lifecycle)
- [Invoices API](https://docs.modempay.com/billing/invoices/api-reference)
